introHtml: Orange paper bags offer a bold, energetic look that stands out in retail settings, trade shows, or corporate gift bags. Whether you choose kraft paper with orange handles or a full orange finish, these bags make your logo pop. They are eco-friendly, customizable with screen printing or foil stamping, and available in various sizes to fit your merchandise.
